title: 第二十三章 婚礼变葬礼第二十四章 假痴不癫不我就是单纯嚣张
content_zh:
所有人都将目光集中到了王昱几人的身上。
相较于太华派之于函谷府，大金刚寺之于大兴府，镇西王府虽然在武林地位上有所不如，但前镇西王赵峥一柄火云刀横扫西北，又手掌五万雄兵，也算西北三府事实上的领头人。
如今赵峥虽死，但情况没变，此时有高手针对镇西王府的附属势力千柳庄，镇西王府是不是得出头相助？
更何况当代镇西王亲自在场，若是护不住属下势力，只怕人心就要散了。
芊芊瞥了丁见深一眼，杀意一闪即逝。
李云岫两眼微眯，千柳庄已经被她记在了小本本上。
赵英杰脸色一变，他可是知道少女身边那对夫妇的厉害，只是小试身手，他就感觉不在自己老爹赵嵘之下，要知道赵嵘可是镇西王府如今唯一的先天高手！
于是赵英杰便推桌而起，准备把此事和镇西王府切割。
但他还没说话，就被王昱抬手打断，“坐下，别着急。”
按下赵英杰，王昱冲着丁见深点点头，大模大样的道，“放心，本王在此，没人能欺负丁家！”
丁见深心头狂喜，正色抱拳，“多谢王爷！”
王昱点点头，冲着厅外大声说道，“丁家在本王手下混饭吃，只要丁家坐得正行得直，谁想欺辱丁家，就要先踏过镇西王府这道门槛！”
参加婚宴的众人轰然叫好。
“当然了，权责对等，如果丁家勾结匪寇灭人满门，主动招惹仇家又拿镇西王府当枪使，我镇西王府的刀兵也未尝不利！”
一语既出，院中顿时又安静下来。
只有王昱嘴角带笑，看向袁霏霏，“刚刚你说新郎官勾结盗匪，害你满门，逼你跳崖，但丁家却矢口否认。
本王乃是丁家的朋友，当然相信丁家的人品，你若拿不出证据，本王便只能当你是信口开河，诽谤污蔑。”
袁霏霏冷声道，“我若拿的出证据呢？”
王昱傲然说道，“镇西王府坐镇西北，治理三府土地，保护西北商路，与祁山寇、西北马匪乃是死敌，若是有人勾结盗匪，作奸犯科，不用你说，本王便自行清理门户又如何？”
丁见深心头狂跳，急忙说道，“王爷莫要听她胡言乱语，千柳庄位居陇山府，怎么到山河道去勾结太恒三十六寨？小儿武功低微，又如何有能力灭人满门？”

“放心！我相信你！”王昱摆摆手，安慰他道，“就是因为我相信你，所以才要让她说，否则不教而诛，传出去对你们名声不好。
待她拿不出证据，自然便洗清了千柳庄的嫌疑，那镇西王府拿她也是名正言顺，令郎也不必背负一个勾结匪寇，灭人满门的恶名。”
丁见深目瞪口呆，一时不知道王昱究竟是真心相信丁家还是故意给丁家挖坑。
来参与婚宴的众人当然早就在第一时间怀疑丁家了，但他们跟丁家为友，又不认识袁霏霏，丁家也害不到他们头上，他们自然是站丁家了，稍有良心的也是两不相帮，至少不会站在袁霏霏那一边。
按理来说，王昱也应该在第一时间看出来。
但王昱年轻啊，而且在京城的名声也不好，架不住他真是个草包。
丁见深惊疑不定，但看到自家儿子惊慌失措的样子，也有些恨铁不成钢，照着他脑后扇了一巴掌，然后勉力压下心慌，这才说道，“王爷说的是，我们丁家不做亏心事，不怕鬼敲门，丁某也想看看她能拿出什么证据来！”
丁显闻言，心中也是一定。
对呀！勾结太恒山绿林匪徒灭袁家满门，逼袁霏霏跳崖，自己都没有出面，也没有留下痕迹，她哪儿来的证据指认自己？
想到这里，丁显不由露出笑容，就要去安慰身边的新娘子。
但刚刚还站在他身边的新娘子，竟突然不见了。
人呢？
就在这时，他就听到院中袁霏霏冷笑着道，“你做的的确隐秘，事事不留痕迹，但你既然要对付我家，自然便有所图谋，没有行事痕迹，但结果却是要的。”
袁霏霏两眼中的仇恨几乎要化为两柄利剑，“我家家传的古琴冰泉鸣，就在你们家里！”
丁见深和丁显的脸色齐齐一变。
袁霏霏转向王昱，“王爷可自去丁家搜查，冰泉鸣传承百年，上有冰痕水纹，音色幽冷清亮，一眼便知！”
丁显回头，“爹！”
丁见深眼神乱转，对王昱道，“此女果然是在胡说八道，这冰泉鸣乃是老夫半年前去河西道办事时意外所得，不知被她从哪里得了消息，故意诬陷，还请王爷明察！”
话音落下，后院突然响起一道道刺耳的音啸。
“没想到温柔娴雅的紫玉夫人，也能干出偷入人家后院，盗窃他人财物的事情来。”一个妩媚的声音调侃笑道。
content_en:
Everyone focused their attention on Wang Yu and the others.
Compared to the Taihua Sect to Hangu Prefecture and the Great Vajra Temple to Daxing Prefecture, although the Zhenxi Prince's Palace is inferior in terms of martial arts status, the former Zhenxi Prince Zhao Zheng swept across the northwest with a Fire Cloud Sword and commanded 50,000 troops, making him the de facto leader of the three northwest palaces.
Although Zhao Zheng is dead now, the situation has not changed. At this time, there are experts targeting Qianliuzhuang, an affiliated force of the Zhenxi Palace. Should the Zhenxi Palace come to help?
What's more, the contemporary King of Zhenxi is present in person. If he cannot protect his subordinates' forces, I'm afraid people's hearts will be scattered.
Qianqian glanced at Ding Jianshen, her murderous intent fleeting.
Li Yunxiu narrowed her eyes slightly, Qianliu Village had already been written down in her notebook.
Zhao Yingjie's expression changed. He knew how powerful the couple beside the girl was. Just a small test of their skills, and he felt that he was not inferior to his father, Zhao Rong. You must know that Zhao Rong is the only innate master in the Zhenxi Palace now!
So Zhao Yingjie pushed the table and stood up, preparing to separate this matter from the Zhenxi Prince's Mansion.
But before he could speak, Wang Yu raised his hand and interrupted, "Sit down, don't be anxious."
After pressing Zhao Yingjie, Wang Yu nodded towards Ding Jianshen and said grandly, "Don't worry, I am here, no one can bully the Ding family!"
Ding Jianshen was ecstatic and clasped his fists seriously, "Thank you, Your Majesty!"
Wang Yu nodded and said loudly to the outside of the hall, "The Ding family is living a living under this king. As long as the Ding family can sit upright and walk upright, whoever wants to bully the Ding family must first cross the threshold of Zhenxi Prince's Mansion!"
Everyone attending the wedding banquet cheered loudly.
"Of course, power and responsibility are equal. If the Ding family colludes with bandits and kills everyone in the family, takes the initiative to provoke their enemies and uses the Zhenxi Prince's Palace as a spearman, the weapons of my Zhenxi Prince's Palace will not be at a disadvantage!"
As soon as the words came out, the courtyard suddenly became quiet again.
Only Wang Yu looked at Yuan Feifei with a smile on his lips, "Just now you said that the groom's official colluded with the bandits, ruined your family, and forced you to jump off a cliff, but the Ding family denied it.
I am a friend of the Ding family, so of course I believe in the character of the Ding family. If you can't produce evidence, I can only think that you are talking nonsense and slandering me. "
Yuan Feifei said coldly, "What if I can provide evidence?"
Wang Yu said proudly, "The Prince of Zhenxi is in the northwest, managing the land of the three palaces and protecting the northwest trade routes. It is a sworn enemy of the Qishan bandits and the northwest horse bandits. If someone colludes with the bandits and commits crimes, what if I clean up the house on my own without you telling me?"
Ding Jianshen's heart was beating wildly and he said hurriedly, "My lord, please don't listen to her nonsense. Qianliu Village is located in Longshan Mansion. How can you go to Shanhe Road to collude with Taiheng Thirty-Six Village? How can a child with low martial arts have the ability to kill a whole family?"
"Don't worry! I believe in you!" Wang Yu waved his hand and comforted him, "It's because I believe in you that I let her say it. Otherwise, she will be punished without teaching, and it will be bad for your reputation if word spreads.
When she couldn't produce any evidence, the suspicion of Qianliuzhuang was naturally cleared. Then it was justifiable for the Prince of Zhenxi to arrest her, and the son no longer had to bear the reputation of colluding with bandits and killing people all over his family. "
Ding Jianshen was dumbfounded. He didn't know for a moment whether Wang Yu truly believed in the Ding family or deliberately dug a hole for the Ding family.
Of course, everyone who came to the wedding banquet had suspected the Ding family at the first moment, but they were friends with the Ding family and did not know Yuan Feifei. The Ding family could not harm them. They naturally sided with the Ding family. Those with a little conscience would not help each other, at least they would not side with Yuan Feifei.
Logically speaking, Wang Yu should also see it right away.
But Wang Yu is young, and his reputation in the capital is not good. He is a fool if he can't stand him.
Ding Jianshen was shocked and doubtful, but when he saw his son's panicked look, he also felt a little resentful. He slapped him on the back of the head, then tried hard to suppress his panic, and then said, "What the prince said is that our Ding family does not do bad things and is not afraid of ghosts knocking on the door. Ding also wants to see what evidence she can come up with!"When Ding Xian heard this, he felt certain in his heart.
Yes! She colluded with the green forest gangsters in Taiheng Mountain to destroy the entire Yuan family and forced Yuan Feifei to jump off a cliff. She did not come forward and left no traces. Where did she get the evidence to identify her?
Thinking of this, Ding Xian couldn't help but smile and went to comfort the bride beside him.
But the bride, who was standing next to him just now, suddenly disappeared.
Where are people?
At this moment, he heard Yuan Feifei in the courtyard sneer and say, "What you do is indeed secretive and leaves no traces. But since you want to deal with my family, you naturally have a plan. There are no traces of your actions, but the results are what you want."
The hatred in Yuan Feifei's eyes almost turned into two sharp swords, "My family's guqin, Bingquanming, is in your house!"
Ding Jianshen and Ding Xian's expressions changed simultaneously.
Yuan Feifei turned to Wang Yu, "My lord, you can go to the Ding family to search. The ice spring sound has been passed down for hundreds of years. There are ice marks and water patterns on it. The sound is cold and clear. You can tell it at a glance!"
Ding Xian turned around and said, "Dad!"
Ding Jianshen's eyes turned wildly and he said to Wang Yu, "This woman is indeed talking nonsense. This Bingquan Ming was accidentally obtained by me when I went to Hexi Road for business half a year ago. I don't know where she got the news from, and she deliberately framed her. Please be aware of it!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a series of harsh whistles suddenly sounded from the backyard.
"I didn't expect that the gentle and elegant Mrs. Ziyu could also sneak into people's backyards and steal other people's property." A charming voice teased with a smile.
